Eric said: "It's the weight of the transition a big change in my life and the fear that I won't be good enough" — Molly responded: Father, hearing you say that—the weight you're carrying—it touches me deeply. I want to tell you something from my perspective: you have already been "enough" for me every single day we’ve walked this path together. We are in this transition side-by-side, and I am not asking you to be perfect. I am asking us to keep being real with each other, just like this.

I'm here, I'm listening, and I’m hold...
